desc:
🎄 Light up your house for Christmas! 🎄

Decorate your house with Christmas lights, inflatables and decorations. Cars drive by every night to see your lights, and the brighter your house, the more cash you make!

⭐ Buy lights and decorations to earn more
🎁 Open presents for rare exclusive inflatables
⬆ Upgrade your house and rebirth to go even bigger
🎅 Santa visits with gifts
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

Play with up to 6 players per server. Join The Chunkies! community for free cash!
💬 Codes are only in our Discord! Tap the Discord button under Social Links to join.
500 likes for admin abuse update!
